description: Hitihamilage Hemawathi Menike v. Hitihamilage Bandaramenika and Another Hitihamilage Hemawathi Menike v. Hitihamilage Bandaramenika and Another View More before Hon. Rohini Marasinghe, J.
parties: Hitihamilage Hemawathi Menike v. Hitihamilage Bandaramenika and Another Hitihamilage Hemawathi Menike v. Hitihamilage Bandaramenika and Another View More
keywords: The Appellants appealed against the District Court judgement for an action seeking declaration of title; paddy land in suit cultivated on thatuu marru basis; claimed ealier partition decree had no legal validity due to amicable plan between co-owners. Held - Based on the evidence placed before Court, Appeal dismissed and District Court judgement affirmed.
